raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #42139. Hunyuan streaming tool calls containing control characters such as `\^_` emit invalid JSON and can corrupt subsequent argument deltas.

## Modifications

Use the same JSON string escaping for partial values as for completed arguments. Add regression coverage for all 32 control characters, quotes, backslashes and Unicode across single-character, seven-character and whole-response chunks.

## Accuracy Tests

Rebased onto `933668131`, including the current required base `60878c3f`. On the unmodified base, the regression fails in 60 control-character/chunking subcases. With the fix, all 627 function-call unit tests pass, including 1731 subtests, and all 45 Hunyuan tests pass through the registered test entry point. These are CPU parser tests using Python 3.12.13, PyTorch 2.13.0, Transformers 5.15.0, and xgrammar 0.2.7.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No model execution or kernel changes.

## Checklist

- [x] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes, including the Rust hooks.
- [x] Add focused regression coverage to the registered CPU test suite.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- [ ] Documentation update — not applicable.
- [ ] Model accuracy and speed benchmarks — not applicable to this parser-only change.

+    def test_streaming_string_arg_json_escaping(self):
+        values = [chr(code) for code in range(32)] + [
+            'quotes " and backslash \\ with 中文 😀',
+            "before\x00\b\f\x1fafter",
+        ]
+        for value in values:
+            text = (
+                "<tool_calls><tool_call>search<tool_sep>"
+                f"<arg_key>query</arg_key><arg_value>{value}</arg_value>"
+                "<arg_key>count</arg_key><arg_value>2</arg_value>"
+                "</tool_call></tool_calls>"
+            )
+            expected = {"query": value, "count": 2}
+            non_streamed = self._new_detector().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+            self.assertEqual(json.loads(non_streamed.calls[0].parameters), expected)
+
+            for chunk_size in (1, 7, len(text)):
+                with self.subTest(value=repr(value), chunk_size=chunk_size):
+                    detector = self._new_detector()
+                    all_calls = []
+                    for start in range(0, len(text), chunk_size):
+                        all_calls.extend(
+                            detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                                text[start : start + chunk_size], self.tools
+                            ).calls
+                        )
+                    collected = _collect_streamed_tool_calls(all_calls)
+                    self.assertEqual(len(collected), 1)
+                    self.assertEqual(collected[0]["name"], "search")
+                    self.assertEqual(json.loads(collected[0]["parameters"]), expected)
